summary: The install now pauses and tells you what it needs, instead of failing.

new.title: The install waits instead of failing
new.text: When the install needs something from you first, such as DNS records, it shows waiting and the reason. Run the same command again and it continues there.

new.title: Network team tasks listed, not blocking
new.text: When your sign-in cannot change your central network, a private install warns you and lists it as a task for your network team instead of stopping.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes for private installs
fixes.text: Network links are checked before the install goes on, parts left broken by an earlier run are made again, and two messages no longer suggest removing shared items.
